remarks: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! Beautiful English Tudor-style home in the Noroton Manor Association with access to a private beach and tennis. An updated gourmet kitchen opens seamlessly into the family room, creating an easy, comfortable flow for everyday living and entertaining. Five bedrooms are located on the upper level, including a spacious primary suite with a fireplace, Juliette balcony, and radiant-heated bathroom floors. The walk-out lower level offers an additional bedroom and kitchen-perfect for guests or an au pair. The backyard is a standout, featuring a bluestone terrace, firepit, and outdoor TV.
